title: Corridor Cost Averages
description: Corridor cost three ways from declared pseudonymous provider quotes - simple, market-share-weighted and lowest-N (SmaRT, default n=3) averages - each vs the SDG 10.c 3 percent and G20 5 percent per-corridor 2030 targets. Weighted is null with a reason code when shares are missing or do not sum to 100; never renormalised. Cost per quote = fee + FX margin as percent of send amount (RPW method, 200/500 reference). Basis-point arithmetic. Malformed quotes refuse.

send_amount.description: Optional send amount in the send currency. Defaults to 200, the RPW reference amount; 500 is the second RPW reference amount.

provider_code.description: Pseudonymous provider code, 1-24 characters of letters, digits, underscore or hyphen. Real provider names are refused.

fee.description: Transfer fee in the send currency, non-negative.

fx_margin_pct.description: Foreign-exchange margin as a percent of the amount sent, non-negative.

market_share_pct.description: Optional provider market share in percent, 0-100. The weighted average needs every quote to carry a share and the shares to sum to 100 within tol

items.description: Declared provider quote. All quotes quote both the fee and the FX margin, so all are SmaRT-eligible (transparent).

quotes.description: Declared provider quotes. Synthetic, pseudonymous inputs only.

lowest_n.description: Optional number of cheapest quotes for the lowest_n average. Default 3, the SmaRT rule.

targets.description: Optional target overrides in percent. Defaults 3 and 5.

input_schema.description: Corridor plus at least one declared provider quote.

inputSchema.description: Corridor plus at least one declared provider quote.

input_schema_provenance: The quotes array is exactly the policy_parameters member the kernel reads; per-quote fee and fx_margin_pct are the values compute() aggregates and market_share_pct is the optional weighting input.
author: PostOakLabs

method_notes: simple: simple average of all quoted total costs - UN SDG indicator 10.c.1 metadata, section 4.c Method of computation.
lowest_n: n=3 cheapest quotes - the SmaRT average, UN SDG indicator 10.c.1 metadata section 4.c (simple average of the three cheapest transparent services in a corridor).

weighted: ANALYST CONVENTION - no pinned primary text defines a market-share-weighted corridor average; motivated by the World Bank RPW survey frame, which samples providers to cover at least 80 percent of corridor market share. Null with a reason code when shares are missing or do not sum to 100 within +/-0.5.

targets: SDG target 10.c - below 3 percent by 2030 (UN SDG 10.c.1 metadata section 0.b); FSB G20 cross-border payments final report 13 Oct 2021 - no retail remittance corridor above 5 percent by 2030.
cost per quote = transfer fee + FX margin as percent of send amount (World Bank RPW methodology); reference send amounts 200 and 500, default 200.
arithmetic: integer basis points, half-up rounding applied once per figure; total_cost_pct = basis points / 100.
synthetic inputs only: quotes are declared pseudonymous provider codes; this node aggregates caller-declared quotes and holds no live data.
output_example.pii_note: ZERO PII: pseudonymous provider codes, fees, margins, shares and corridor codes only. No person, account or real provider identity enters this kernel.
output_example.adjacency_note: averages.simple.total_cost_pct (or the chosen average) can feed compare_corridor_cost (art-249) as the declared corridor cost for target comparison.
